title: WordPress provision: a bind or inspect answer that is not JSON says curl's exit code and HTTP status; Apply's note about an unbound site claims no cause
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/wordpress-quickstart.test.mjs

S3: Record each run's exit code and '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines, and whether the tests 'a bind or inspect answer that is not JSON says what curl saw, and never the token' (S1) and 'an unbound site is said without a cause the refusal does not give' (S2) are 'ok'.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'; the named test is 'ok': an empty reply (curl exit 52) and an HTTP 502 with an empty body each produce a '!!' line naming the curl exit code and HTTP status, the bound / already bound / refused paths keep their words, and the token appears in no output.

S2 exits 0 with '# fail 0'; the named test is 'ok': the unbound note reads 'this site is not bound to its template’s content contract, so it keeps the template’s words' and names no plugin or profile.
evidence: 05/10/2026 local stand: a ja-kinetic wp7 1.0.3 site was handed over unbound after '!! the Claude Cowork plugin did not answer the bind with JSON: ' (empty; 1 of 265 binds on the host); minutes later an inspect with the same contract answered fine, and Apply said the plugin did not carry the profile, which it did (ledger L29).
fence: Only what is logged and said changes; what binds, when, and the refusal paths do not. The root cause of the empty answer is still unknown.
